macro_features.name: ema20_ema50_spread_atr
macro_features.missing_value_behavior: Warmup NaN for first 50 5m bars; guard ATR>1e-9
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Correlated with ema20_slope and adx_14; normalize by ATR for scale invariance across $3,500-$4,500 gold.

macro_features.name: ema20_slope
macro_features.formula: (EMA20_t - EMA20_{t-1}) / ATR14_t (raw slope in USD/bar normalized by ATR)
macro_features.redundancy_notes: G2 found raw unscaled ema20_slope saturated TradeScorer; use ATR-normalized continuous value for ML.

macro_features.name: h1_ema20_ema50_trend
macro_features.formula: (H1_EMA20 - H1_EMA50) / H1_close on strictly completed H1 bars (< cutoff_1h)
macro_features.leakage_risk: LOW if cutoff_1h strictly < current hour (verified in RunBacktestUseCase & ScanMarketUseCase)
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Low collinearity with 5m features; captures multi-day drift.

macro_features.name: rsi_14_5m
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Moderate correlation with bb_position and short-term return.

macro_features.name: atr_14_5m_pct_and_ratio
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Use ATR/close (scale-free) rather than raw USD ATR because XAUUSD ranged ~$3,500-$4,500 across Aug-Nov.

macro_features.name: adx_14_5m
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Core regime discriminator; pairs well with signed EMA spread.

macro_features.name: bb_width_and_position_20
macro_features.redundancy_notes: bb_width correlates with atr_14_pct; bb_position correlates with rsi_14.

macro_features.name: kaufman_er_20
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Use raw ER in [0,1] (G2 showed TradeScorer clipping at 0.35 saturated it).

macro_features.name: shannon_entropy_20
macro_features.formula: Shannon entropy of 5m returns over rolling 20-bar window
macro_features.leakage_risk: LOW if bin edges are fixed or fit strictly inside train fold
macro_features.redundancy_notes: G2 proved fixed bin_width=0.005 caused 100% saturation (entropy=0) on 5m XAUUSD returns. Must recalibrate bin width to ~0.0005 or ATR-standardized returns before ML use.

macro_features.name: regime_state_5m
macro_features.leakage_risk: LOW; hysteresis creates short-term state persistence (handled by 60m embargo)
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Derived nonlinear combination of ADX, EMA, ATR ratio.

macro_features.name: tick_weighted_price_dist
macro_features.formula: (close - TWP) / TWP where TWP is tick-count-weighted typical price (NOT traded VWAP)
macro_features.offline_vs_shadow_parity: MINOR_PARITY_GAP (ScanMarketUseCase:204 divides by close; RunBacktestUseCase divides by TWP; diff <0.01%)
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Must be labeled tick_weighted_price_dist, never VWAP (real_volume is 100% NULL).

macro_features.name: tick_rate_ratio
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Measures broker quote-arrival bursts (liquidity/volatility proxy), NOT traded volume.

macro_features.name: dist_to_20bar_swing_high_low_atr
macro_features.redundancy_notes: Strong independent exhaustion/support signal observed in G1/G2 SELL diagnostics.

macro_features.name: kalman_price_dist_vel_accel
macro_features.formula: (close - k_price)/ATR14, k_vel/ATR14, k_accel/ATR14 from 2D scalar Kalman
macro_features.redundancy_notes: k_vel sign inverted between Dev and Holdout in prior SELL research; regularize heavily.

micro_features.name: spread_usd_and_zscore_30t
micro_features.formula: (ask - bid) and z-score over trailing 30 valid ticks
micro_features.offline_vs_shadow_parity: EXACT if live tick stream filters bid>0 & ask>0 & bid<ask
micro_features.redundancy_notes: Directly predicts execution cost hurdle; median spread is $0.07.

micro_features.name: mid_return_5t_10t_30t
micro_features.redundancy_notes: Core microstructure signal; test for mean-reversion vs momentum.

micro_features.name: quote_arrival_burst_ratio
micro_features.source_module: derived from valid market_ticks (or microstructure_feature_repo burst_ratio)
micro_features.redundancy_notes: Measures quote-arrival bursts (NOT traded order-flow volume).

micro_features.name: interarrival_time_stats_10t
micro_features.formula: mean(dt_s) and cv(dt_s) over trailing 10 valid ticks

micro_features.name: bid_ask_revision_imbalance_30t
micro_features.formula: (count(bid_up or ask_up) - count(bid_dn or ask_dn)) / 30 over last 30 ticks
micro_features.redundancy_notes: Valid top-of-book quote-revision asymmetry; does NOT claim to be L2 order book or trade aggressor.

micro_features.name: realized_vol_30t
micro_features.formula: sqrt(sum((mid_k - mid_{k-1})^2)) over trailing 30 valid ticks
micro_features.redundancy_notes: Determines whether 30-tick move can clear spread+commission hurdle.

micro_features.name: kalman_vel_accel_tick
micro_features.formula: Per-tick scalar Kalman velocity and acceleration

micro_features.name: lee_ready_order_flow_and_l2_depth
micro_features.formula: Lee-Ready aggressor (price>=ask / price<=bid) & Level II book imbalance
micro_features.missing_value_behavior: Explicitly disabled in compute_forex_micro_features() and blocked by validate_ml_feature_names() (raises ValueError).
micro_features.redundancy_notes: RESOLVED (G3.1 corrective pass): Disabled in microstructure_feature_repo.py and strictly excluded by ml_feature_contract.EXCLUDED_UNAVAILABLE_ML_FEATURES so it cannot enter ML training.
